candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) with DependencyUnavailable, causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503 and order/checkout to fail with ReadTimeout and 502 at the gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: No Redis-side metrics/logs admitted; root cause of the Redis timeout (saturation, network, config) is not established.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timing out (~2s) with DependencyUnavailable across multiple correlation IDs, propagating 503 from inventory and ReadTimeout/502 through order and checkout. Gateway metrics show 16 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2425ms. Topology confirms inventory->redis dependency. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis-side telemetry to confirm the timeout originates at Redis rather than the inventory client
